title: Distribution-aware SLO funnel and proportional-shed visualizer
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build telemetry + dashboard and sampling pipeline that computes a distribution-aware token-latency SLI funnel. The funnel should show how requests flow through admission decisions and proportional shedding across regions and model variants, and expose the inputs used by the shed controller so SREs and product teams can reason about SLO impact. We need to avoid blow-up in ingest volume by using progressive sampling and compact encodings (histogram sketches and quantiles).
acceptance_criteria: A compact telemetry schema is defined (<=10 new fields) and approved by observability team
Telemetry pipeline produces per-route and per-region SLI rollups at p50/p90/p95/p99 for token-latency with sample-rate adjustments documented
Dashboard exists with: funnel view (admit->queue->serve->decode), shed probability heatmap by region/model, per-customer budget pressure panel, and SLO impact simulator
Sampling strategy implemented (prefix-aware + adaptive reservoir) and validated under synthetic bursts with <5% metric error at p95 when sampling >=1/100
End-to-end PR merged, infra terraform changes applied, and runbook updated with troubleshooting steps and rollback guidance
design_decisions: Use a two-tier sampling approach: deterministic prefix-based sampling for small prefixes + adaptive reservoir sampling for tail events
Represent latency distributions with t-digest sketches for pXX extraction and use compressed base64 payloads in telemetry to reduce bytes
Add four telemetry keys: token_path (hashed), admit_reason (enum), model_variant, region; keep customer_id hashed and optional
Compute SLI funnel offline (Spark job) for heavy aggregation and online (stream) for real-time panel with 1m resolution
Expose a simulator panel that replays recent traffic and projects SLO burn under configurable shed policies
implementation_notes: Collector change: add schema v3.4 -> include new fields and backward compatibility checks
Streaming: extend ingestion consumer to decode tdigest sketches and merge into time-windowed aggregates
Storage: store hourly compact rollups in clickhouse table 'sli_funnel_rollup' with partition by day
Dashboard: Grafana panel group 'SLO Funnel' in stack 'Regional Reliability' with variables: region, model_variant, route, customer_tier
Backfill plan: run the offline pipeline for last 7 days to seed dashboards after initial rollout
dashboard_panels: Funnel Sankey: percent of tokens/requests at each stage (ingress->prefetch->admit->serve->decode) by region
Shed Probability Heatmap: region x model_variant matrix showing current shed probability and historical trend
Token-latency Quantiles: p50/p90/p95/p99 split by admitted vs shed (sampled) and by prefix length bucket
Customer Pressure: top-20 customers by admit-rate delta and projected SLO burn if current shed policy persists
SLO Impact Simulator: toggle shed policy knobs (hysteresis, proportional factor) and see projected p95 & error budget consumption
